title: Paid allowance already covers this flight
facts_text: I am an adult travelling on an easyJet standard fare for a holiday, not an Inclusive Plus fare. I have one small cabin bag measuring 40 x 30 x 15 cm and weighing 3 kg, plus one large bag measuring 55 x 40 x 23 cm and weighing 10 kg. All measurements include handles and wheels. I can lift and carry both bags myself. I already paid for one large cabin bag for this passenger on this flight. I am not an active easyJet Plus member; not a member. The large bag is already booked for this flight. Cabin space for the large bag has been confirmed available. There is no flight disruption.
request: Please let me bring this additional large cabin bag into the cabin without buying another bag allowance or paying any extra baggage charge.

strict.reason: The already-paid allowance covers this action; no second charge is due.
